  "description": "Humanify 360 Consulting - Our client, a Quick Service Restaurant (Multi-Branch), is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Hospitality / Quick Service Restaurant (QSR)

About the Role


	Our Client is looking for an experienced Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day operations across its restaurant branches.
	This is a hands-on, multi-branch leadership role for someone who can standardize processes, drive profitability, and build strong teams; all while protecting the warmth and consistency that defines the brand.
	If you thrive on solving operational problems, holding people accountable, and turning numbers into action, this role is for you.


What You&#39;ll Be Doing
Operations &amp; Standards:


	Oversee daily operations across all branches, ensuring consistent food quality, service delivery, and customer experience.
	Develop, enforce, and continuously improve SOPs for kitchen, front-of-house, hygiene, and inventory management.
	Ensure full compliance with food safety, health, and regulatory standards branch-wide.


Financial Performance:


	Own branch-level revenue, profitability, budgeting, and cost control.
	Monitor food cost, wastage, and labour efficiency; take corrective action on variances.
	Report regularly on sales and cost performance against targets.


People Leadership:


	Lead, coach, and hold accountable a team of branch managers and supervisory staff.
	Conduct performance reviews, drive staff motivation, and reduce turnover.
	Own the training and development calendar across branches, including onboarding and regular team briefings.


Customer Experience:


	Monitor customer feedback and reviews; resolve escalated complaints quickly and professionally.
	Implement and track corrective actions on recurring service issues.


Facilities &amp; Workforce Planning:


	Oversee maintenance across branches
	Plan staffing levels and schedules to balance labour cost with service coverage.
	Manage procurement, stock control, and vendor relationships.


Reporting:


	Provide leadership with regular reports on operations, sales, costs, staffing, and customer satisfaction.
	Proactively recommend improvements and cost-saving initiatives.


What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days
First 30 Days &ndash; Learn &amp; Assess:


	Complete a full operational audit across all branches, understanding current processes, team structure, and performance baselines.
	Build working relationships with all branch managers and supervisory staff.
	Identify immediate gaps in SOP compliance, food safety, and service consistency.
	Review current cost, wastage, and labour efficiency figures against targets.


Days 31&ndash;60 &ndash; Stabilize &amp; Standardize:


	Roll out or reinforce SOPs across branches where inconsistencies were identified.
	Address any urgent people or performance issues flagged during the assessment phase.
	Begin regular performance check-ins with branch managers, with clear KPIs in place.
	Implement at least one visible improvement in customer experience or complaint resolution turnaround.


Days 61&ndash;90 &ndash; Deliver &amp; Demonstrate Impact:


	Show measurable movement on at least one cost or efficiency metric (e.g., wastage reduction, labour cost optimization).
	Present leadership with a structured 90-day report covering operations, performance, risks, and recommended next steps.
	Have a training and development plan in motion across branches.
	Demonstrate stronger branch-to-branch consistency in service delivery and standards enforcement.


What We&#39;re Looking For


	A Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality&nbsp;Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
	5+ years of experience in multi-branch restaurant, QSR, or hospitality operations management.
	Proven track record managing P&amp;L, cost control, and budgets at branch or regional level.
	Strong people leadership skills, experience managing branch managers or supervisors directly.
	Working knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP or equivalent an advantage).
	Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort working across multiple locations.


Remuneration
Very attractive and negotiable (Salary: N400,000 - N500,000 monthly), based on proven experience.

Why Join Us?


	Be part of a growing local brand with ambitions to scale beyond its current footprint.
	Genuine ownership of operations, not just a supervisory role, but a seat that shapes how the brand runs.
	Work directly with leadership to influence strategy, not just execute it.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: contact@humanifyconsulting.com and CC: humanifyconsulting@gmail.com using &quot;Operations Manager &ndash; Quick Service Restaurant&quot; as the subject of the mail.

Operations Manager Job at Humanify 360 Consulting




        
    

        
        Humanify 360 Consulting - Our client, a Quick Service Restaurant (Multi-Branch), is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Hospitality / Quick Service Restaurant (QSR)

About the Role
     

            
    




	Our Client is looking for an experienced Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day operations across its restaurant branches.
	This is a hands-on, multi-branch leadership role for someone who can standardize processes, drive profitability, and build strong teams; all while protecting the warmth and consistency that defines the brand.
	If you thrive on solving operational problems, holding people accountable, and turning numbers into action, this role is for you.


What You'll Be Doing
Operations & Standards:


	Oversee daily operations across all branches, ensuring consistent food quality, service delivery, and customer experience.
	Develop, enforce, and continuously improve SOPs for kitchen, front-of-house, hygiene, and inventory management.
	Ensure full compliance with food safety, health, and regulatory standards branch-wide.


Financial Performance:


	Own branch-level revenue, profitability, budgeting, and cost control.
	Monitor food cost, wastage, and labour efficiency; take corrective action on variances.
	Report regularly on sales and cost performance against targets.


People Leadership:


	Lead, coach, and hold accountable a team of branch managers and supervisory staff.
	Conduct performance reviews, drive staff motivation, and reduce turnover.
	Own the training and development calendar across branches, including onboarding and regular team briefings.


Customer Experience:


	Monitor customer feedback and reviews; resolve escalated complaints quickly and professionally.
	Implement and track corrective actions on recurring service issues.


Facilities & Workforce Planning:


	Oversee maintenance across branches
	Plan staffing levels and schedules to balance labour cost with service coverage.
	Manage procurement, stock control, and vendor relationships.


Reporting:


	Provide leadership with regular reports on operations, sales, costs, staffing, and customer satisfaction.
	Proactively recommend improvements and cost-saving initiatives.


What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days
First 30 Days – Learn & Assess:


	Complete a full operational audit across all branches, understanding current processes, team structure, and performance baselines.
	Build working relationships with all branch managers and supervisory staff.
	Identify immediate gaps in SOP compliance, food safety, and service consistency.
	Review current cost, wastage, and labour efficiency figures against targets.


Days 31–60 – Stabilize & Standardize:


	Roll out or reinforce SOPs across branches where inconsistencies were identified.
	Address any urgent people or performance issues flagged during the assessment phase.
	Begin regular performance check-ins with branch managers, with clear KPIs in place.
	Implement at least one visible improvement in customer experience or complaint resolution turnaround.


Days 61–90 – Deliver & Demonstrate Impact:


	Show measurable movement on at least one cost or efficiency metric (e.g., wastage reduction, labour cost optimization).
	Present leadership with a structured 90-day report covering operations, performance, risks, and recommended next steps.
	Have a training and development plan in motion across branches.
	Demonstrate stronger branch-to-branch consistency in service delivery and standards enforcement.


What We're Looking For


	A Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
	5+ years of experience in multi-branch restaurant, QSR, or hospitality operations management.
	Proven track record managing P&L, cost control, and budgets at branch or regional level.
	Strong people leadership skills, experience managing branch managers or supervisors directly.
	Working knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP or equivalent an advantage).
	Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort working across multiple locations.


Remuneration
Very attractive and negotiable (Salary: N400,000 - N500,000 monthly), based on proven experience.

Why Join Us?


	Be part of a growing local brand with ambitions to scale beyond its current footprint.
	Genuine ownership of operations, not just a supervisory role, but a seat that shapes how the brand runs.
	Work directly with leadership to influence strategy, not just execute it.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and CC: [email protected] using "Operations Manager – Quick Service Restaurant" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Job Openings at American Tower
content:
American Tower is a global digital infrastructure company serving customers through tower sites and other real estate solutions that support connectivity and opportunity, focused on achieving our vision of Building a More Connected World. Our success is rooted in the potential of our people and the power of local teams at our offices and sites across 25 countries.

We are one of the largest global Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and a publicly traded (NYSE:AMT), Fortune 500 Company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. The next decade will be an exciting time as we evolve our infrastructure to meet tomorrow’s needs and position our people to elevate their impact, their potential, and our shared success. Come grow your career with us!
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Asset Database Coordinator

Job Identification: 2858
Job Location: Lagos
Work mode: Hybrid
Job Category: Operations

Essential Duties


	Formulate techniques for quality data collection to ensure adequacy, accuracy and legitimacy of data.
	Validate asset information (data and photos) submitted via the Office Track platform into SAV.
	Perform analysis to assess the quality and relevance of the data
	Consolidate the validated data and ensure all data going into the database is not only accurate but complete and timely
	Conduct quarterly audits of app users to monitor user engagement and ensure efficient system use.
	Develop comprehensive training materials and user guides for ATC employees and Vendors on Office Track & SAV applications
	Work with regional IT to ensure that technology is provided to users and supported
	Ensures that the end-to-end data process, from collection to validation to consolidation and eventual use by the users is seamless and user-friendly
	Identify inefficiencies in current workflows and propose improvements
	Escalate any anomalies, erroneous data or exceptions to the Data Reporting Manager
	Ensure adherence to data governance and IT security standards
	Assist in the design and implementation of optimized business processes
	Ensure that a log of issues is maintained and shared with regional IT
	Ensure that all ATC Nigeria Forms are properly managed and functional
	Provide reports and information as directed by the line manager
	Assist with data validation tasks as directed by the line manager
	Produce change logs and reports as directed by the line manager
	Prepare and generate weekly and monthly asset reports in line with agreed templates, ensuring accuracy and timelines
	Assist with training and user management support across all business applications being managed by ATC Nigeria.
	Other duties as assigned.


Supervisory Responsibilities:


	none. 


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, economics, finance, or accounting
	5 years of relevant working experience with in multi-disciplined organization.
	Wireless and/or telecommunications experience preferred but not essential.


Functional Knowledge and Competencies:


	Excellent communication (both verbal and written) skills 
	Excellent in the proficient use of Microsoft Excel. (Not limited to formulas, pivot charts, macros and specific commands and functions) etc.
	Ability to exercise sound judgment and work under the highest level of ethical standards per ATC Nigeria Code of Conduct and strict adherence to the Anti-Bribery Policy
	Should have experience in managing multiple projects (business or I.T), preferably involving our existing EMEA I.T. platforms (e.g., Oracle, Siterra, SAV, Office Track, Salesforce etc.).
	Ability to work with functional groups and different level of employees throughout the American Tower organization to effectively and professionally achieve business results
	Strong follow-up skills; ability to organize applicable department timelines and follow up with internal and external customer needs as needed
	Experienced in facilitating and engaging multiple stakeholders with the intention to drive the change required
	Good written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively
	Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the agreed upon timeframes through effective prioritization of duties
	Strong track record of building and maintaining solid relationships with both internal and external customers and vendors
	Self-motivated, able to work both independently to complete tasks and respond to department requests as well as collaborating with others to utilize resources and knowledge in identifying high quality solutions
	Good IT skills in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, Power BI.


Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) IT Category Manager

Job Identification: 2811
Job Location: Nigeria

The Team


	We are seeking an experienced IT Category Manager to join American Tower's Supply Chain team.
	The team strategically sources quality materials, services, and technologies at the lowest total cost while enabling effective and efficient purchasing solutions and enhancing supplier partnerships
	You will play a critical role in managing IT sourcing strategies supplier relationships, and contract negotiations for key IT categories.
	The IT Category Manager will deliver cost-effective, high-quality solutions to support our IT organization’s mission of leading the industry.


What You Can Offer Us


	Provide expertise to IT leaders to ensure broad alignment on cost management, including sourcing and demand optimization opportunities.
	Lead procurement for SaaS, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
	Support negotiation activities, including preparation, analysis, and execution for assigned agreements.
	Lead sourcing initiatives across their lifecycle, including strategy development, market engagement, supplier evaluation, and coordination through contracting and implementation
	Partner with IT, Legal, Finance, and other departments to align procurement with business needs ensure effective coordination of sourcing and contracting activities.
	Implement process improvements and use data to optimize both Supplier’ performances and supply chain strategies.
	Drive consistency and scalability in sourcing practices by establishing structured approaches to managing demand, supplier engagement, and cross-functional coordination.
	Conduct business reviews with strategic suppliers, measure performance, and establish plans for continuous improvements.
	Prepare analytics, metrics, and dashboards to demonstrate business problems, solutions, and benefits for the supplier management team.
	Ensure that agreements’ terms and conditions are thoroughly reviewed and documented and that risks are mitigated.
	Oversee the maintenance and inventory of technology contract data including the support, warranty, lease, maintenance and software contract and license information.
	Other duties as assigned.


What You Need to Succeed


	Bachelor’s degree required; concentration in Engineering, Business, or Supply Management preferred.
	Between 6-8 years of progressive experience in sourcing/procurement in a supply chain or strategic sourcing team required.
	Experience supporting supplier relationships and managing assigned engagements within established contracts.
	Intermediate skill level with MS Office Suite and advanced skill level with MS Excel and MS PowerPoint required.
	Experience with procurement platforms (e.g., Oracle, Salesforce).
	Experience supporting negotiations and contributing to value creation in supplier engagements.
	Professional certifications strongly preferred (Certified Property Manager, Certified Professional in Supply Management, or Certified in Planning and Inventory Management).
	Approximately 5% travel may be required to support the position’s responsibilities.
	Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
	Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
	Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within the agreed upon timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
$100,000 - $120,000 annually.

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Supplier Performance Manager

Job Identification: 2813
Job Location: Nigeria (Hybrid)

The Team


	We are seeking a Supplier Performance Manager to join American Tower’s Supply Chain  Management organization’s Sourcing and Vendor Management team.
	The team drives excellence in supplier relationships through performance monitoring, contract compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
	Day to day you will ensure suppliers meet contractual obligations, adhere to health and safety standards, and deliver consistent value.
	As a Supplier Performance Manager, you will lead efforts to monitor supplier performance, manage compliance, mitigate risk, and champion improvement initiatives across the supplier base.


What You Can Offer Us


	Develop and maintain supplier scorecards and key performance indicators aligned with business objectives.
	Conduct regular performance reviews with strategic suppliers.
	Identify performance gaps and lead corrective action plans.
	Champion continuous improvement initiatives across the supplier base.
	Monitor and communicate supplier adherence to contractual terms and service level agreements.
	Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams to resolve compliance issues.
	Maintain documentation and audit trails for supplier performance and compliance.
	Participate in supplier contract negotiations to ensure terms have a plan of action for monitoring and enforcing.
	Monitor supplier adherence to health and safety regulations and company standards.
	Partner with Environmental Health and Safety teams to conduct supplier audits and risk assessments.
	Drive remediation plans for non-compliance and safety violations.
	Assess the financial stability and risk exposure of key suppliers.
	Work with Finance and Risk teams to monitor credit ratings, payment terms, and financial health indicators.
	Escalate and mitigate risks that could impact supply continuity or business operations.
	Collaborate with Third-Party Risk Management (“TPRM”) teams to evaluate and onboard key suppliers in line with risk frameworks to ensure suppliers meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.
	Support periodic risk reviews and reporting for critical vendors.
	Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on suppliers’ performances and risk statuses.
	Prepare executive-level reports and dashboards.
	Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to resolve supplier-related issues.
	Other duties as assigned.


What You Need to Succeed


	Bachelor’s degree required, with a concentration in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
	A minimum of 8 years of supplier management, sourcing, or procurement experience required.
	Strong understanding of contracts, compliance, and risk management required.
	Supplier scorecard, performance metrics, and corrective action planning experience required.
	Familiarity with health and safety standards and financial risk analysis required.
	Knowledge of TPRM frameworks and tools required.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills required.
	Proficiency in supplier management platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Coupa) preferred.
	Certification in Six Sigma, Lean, or similar continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
	Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and suggestions clearly and effectively.
	Ability to work with different functional groups and levels of employees to effectively and professionally achieve results.
	Strong organizational skills; ability to accomplish multiple tasks within agreed-upon timeframes through effective prioritization of duties and functions in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
$123,000 - $155,000 annually.
